correctness.rationale: An incidence R_i is allowed precisely when h_i<h_(i+1)<h_(i+2), and L_j precisely when h_(j+1)<h_j<h_(j-1). Thus opposite colors conflict iff (j-i) mod n lies in {0,1,2}. Any compatible partial edge orientation extends to a total vertex order unless it forces one directed full cycle. Three incidences cover at most 6 edges, hence the exact two-skeleton n>=7 and four exceptional monochromatic triples n=6. Same-color 2-skeleta fill each triangular loop, including exception fillings via a vertex on the disjoint same-color missing triangle. Allowed cross bipartite graph is connected (consecutive Rs have common L for n>=6); mixed triangles identify all cross edges after van Kampen contraction, so pi1 is trivial. Earlier Proposition 8.5 gives n=5 S1 sharpness. Independent enumeration from all vertex permutations n=5..8 reproduced face constraints, 4 n=6 missing triples, and connected mixed graph; direct finite H1 is not substituted for pi1 argument.
